name: SmoothQuant reference implementation (PyTorch W8A8)
notable_features: Offline outlier migration then INT8 linear layers
W8A8 via torch._int_mm / fake-quant W8A8W8 path
Three smoothing strengths O1 (per-channel static) / O2 (per-token dynamic) / O3 (per-tensor static)
hardware_caveats: The reference repo is an evaluation harness, not a serving runtime: its INT8 path is PyTorch, so its own latency numbers are not representative of the FasterTransformer INT8 kernels used for the paper's speed claims
notes: IMPORTANT methodology point for every SmoothQuant quality delta in this repo: the accuracy numbers come from this PyTorch harness (evaluated with lm-eval-harness), while the 1.51x/1.56x speedups come from the FasterTransformer INT8 integration. Accuracy and speed in that paper are NOT from the same runtime. O1-O3 are different schemes, not different strengths of one scheme: O3 is per-tensor static and is the one that loses accuracy on OPT-175B.
